value.title: El Cuaderno del Doctor Wulf
value.synopsis: Rebeca makes a bad first impression with Martin; Roque, Carolina and Vicky are lured into the woods and the police search for Elsa's father.

value.title: Amnesia
value.synopsis: Amelia's gun and Javier's slingshot prompt Paula to start a private anti-violence campaign, confiscating and disposing of all weaponry at the school.

value.title: El Hombre del Saco
value.synopsis: Thanks to Jacques' insensitivity, Paula and Evelyn believe the bogeyman has devoured baby Samuel and they must somehow break the news to Elsa.

value.title: La Novia Cadaver
value.synopsis: Noiret continues to look for the papers missing from his safe. Lucas has another dream. Marcos realizes who the baby really is. Another student dies.

value.title: La Promesa
value.synopsis: Don Joaquin's body is found. More details about Rebeca's past are shown. Paula and Evelyn try to win back Jacinta. Marcos and Carolina get into more trouble. Julia finds out who her ghost is. Ivan turns in his father.

value.title: El Vampiro
value.synopsis: Paula and Evelyn find a bat and think it's Camilo. Marcos and his friends explore the lab in the passages. Hector and Jacinto piece together more of the Gemini Project.

value.title: El Rey de la Baraja
value.synopsis: Two days till the end of term and escape from the boarding school horrors, but with an unnamed student scheduled for death, Marcos' group wonders who it might be.

value.title: Paula en el Pais de las Maravillas
value.synopsis: Appearing as Alice in a school production of Alice in Wonderland, Paula questions the condition of madness - perception or dysfunction - and believes Julia needs help.

value.title: El Último Día
value.synopsis: End of term. Summer vacation. Statements of farewell with hopes to leave forever, and others' plans to counter those plans. Many secrets finally revealed, and new developments arise.
